items.abstract: <jats:p>This paper introduces FUSION (Flexible Universal Systemic Intelligent Operational Network), a revolutionary multi-agent artificial intelligence architecture designed to address complex problem-solving challenges across diverse domains. Unlike traditional monolithic AI approaches, FUSION employs a modular, adaptive agent ecosystem that enables dynamic reconfiguration for optimal performance. Comparative testing between parallel and sequential processing reveals significant improvements, with 34.5% reduction in token consumption, 32.2% hallucination reduction, and 55.1% processing speed improvement. Notably, FUSION demonstrates substantially greater performance gains when compared to single-agent systems, highlighting its capacity for combinatorial agent generation and endless implementation possibilities.</jats:p>
title: FUSION: A Novel Multi-Agent Architecture for Complex Problem-Solving
